description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §2.12, §5.4, §5.9, decision 31): the woodfolk of Hollowmere - their elder Sedge, the folk of the stilt village and their hunters in the Greywood (members carry faction "woodfolk"). Neutral until offended (two offences within 30 s: a blow on one of them); its folk step aside for a giant at peace with them. Winning their oath (either resolution) sets faction.woodfolk.allied and lights Hollowmere's lanterns. Hostile, its hunters fight; Sedge reconciles the village for 2 iron.

reconcile.text: Make good the fright you gave Hollowmere (2 iron)

warn_text: Hollowmere's folk scatter into the reeds. Strike them again and the woodfolk will turn their bows on you.
hostile_text: A horn sounds over the black pond: the woodfolk take up their bows against you.
reconciled_text: Sedge accepts the iron. The woodfolk will tolerate you again.
